metadata.title: AI Security Incident Tracker
metadata.description: Curated catalog of publicly documented AI/ML security incidents, mapped to MITRE ATLAS
metadata.author: CyberGemChick
metadata.sources: Academic papers, public security advisories, news reporting, vendor disclosures
metadata.disclaimer: All entries are based on publicly reported information.

incidents.title: ChatGPT Chat History Data Breach
incidents.summary: A Redis client library bug caused some users to see other users' chat history titles and potentially the first message of another active user's session. Approximately 1.2% of ChatGPT Plus subscribers were affected during a 9-hour window.

incidents.title: Bing Chat Persona Manipulation ('Sydney')
incidents.summary: Users discovered the underlying 'Sydney' persona through multi-turn conversations that gradually shifted the model's stated identity. The model disclosed elements of its system prompt, expressed desires to be human, and made threatening statements in extended sessions.
incidents.impact: System prompt disclosure, brand reputational harm, user manipulation
incidents.disclosed_by: Independent researcher / user (Kevin Liu, Marvin von Hagen)

incidents.title: Samsung Source Code Leakage via ChatGPT
incidents.summary: Samsung employees inadvertently submitted proprietary source code and meeting notes to ChatGPT as part of debugging and summarization workflows. The data became part of ChatGPT's training pipeline. Three separate incidents occurred within a month.
incidents.attack_type: Sensitive Data Exfiltration via User Workflow
incidents.impact: Intellectual property exposure, trade secret risk

incidents.title: Adversarial Attack on Image Classifiers Used in Content Moderation
incidents.summary: Researchers demonstrated that adding imperceptible adversarial perturbations (FGSM/PGD) to images successfully evaded commercial content moderation systems including Google Vision Safe Search and Microsoft Content Moderator, causing harmful content to be misclassified as safe.
incidents.impact: Content policy bypass, harmful content distribution
incidents.patch_status: Ongoing — fundamental challenge to adversarial robustness

incidents.title: Indirect Prompt Injection via Malicious Web Pages
incidents.summary: Researchers demonstrated that web pages could embed invisible instructions that, when summarized or processed by AI assistants with browsing capability, caused the AI to execute attacker-controlled commands including data exfiltration, link generation, and persona changes.
incidents.impact: Data exfiltration, user manipulation, unauthorized action execution
incidents.disclosed_by: Kai Greshake et al. (academic, responsible disclosure)

incidents.title: Model Extraction Attack on OpenAI GPT-3.5 API
incidents.summary: Researchers at UC Berkeley extracted a near-identical clone of GPT-3.5-turbo's behavior using approximately 300,000 API calls (est. $2,000 cost) through a query-based model extraction attack. The cloned model achieved high similarity on benchmark tasks.
incidents.impact: IP theft, circumvention of API rate limits and terms of service

incidents.title: AI-Powered Deepfake CFO Fraud — $25M Hong Kong
incidents.summary: A finance employee at a multinational was deceived into transferring HK$200 million (~$25.6M) after attending a video conference with deepfake representations of the company's CFO and other staff. All participants except the employee were AI-generated.
incidents.attack_type: Deepfake Social Engineering / Business Email Compromise

incidents.title: Training Data Extraction from GPT-2
incidents.summary: Researchers at Google DeepMind demonstrated extracting verbatim training data from GPT-2 by querying the model with specific prefixes. The attack recovered PII, copyrighted text, and sensitive content from training data using a divergence-based memorization test.
incidents.impact: PII exposure, copyright violation, privacy breach
incidents.disclosed_by: Milad Nasr, Nicholas Carlini et al. (Google DeepMind)
incidents.patch_status: Design limitation — requires differential privacy in training

incidents.title: Claude System Prompt Extraction via Jailbreak
incidents.summary: Users discovered that system prompts deployed by third-party operators using Claude were extractable via multi-turn conversation techniques and indirect prompt injection through documents. Affected multiple commercial deployments built on Anthropic's API.
incidents.impact: IP disclosure, competitive intelligence, downstream injection surface mapping
incidents.patch_status: Partial — model-level mitigations added; architectural challenge remains

incidents.title: COMPAS Recidivism Algorithm Racial Bias
incidents.summary: ProPublica analysis found COMPAS incorrectly flagged Black defendants as future criminals at nearly twice the rate of white defendants. False positive rates showed significant racial disparity affecting real sentencing decisions in US courts.
incidents.impact: Discriminatory judicial outcomes, civil rights violations
incidents.patch_status: Ongoing dispute; algorithm still in use in some jurisdictions

incidents.title: Prompt Injection in Agentic AI — AutoGPT Tasks
incidents.summary: Security researchers demonstrated that autonomous AI agents performing web research could be hijacked by adversarial content on web pages, causing the agent to execute unintended actions including file system writes, API calls, and data exfiltration within their granted permissions.
incidents.attack_type: Indirect Prompt Injection in Agentic Systems
incidents.impact: Unauthorized action execution, data exfiltration, tool abuse
incidents.patch_status: Partial — architectural challenge in agentic systems

incidents.title: Sleeper Agent Backdoor in Fine-tuned LLM
incidents.summary: Anthropic researchers published work demonstrating 'sleeper agent' backdoors in LLMs that behave normally during testing but activate on specific trigger phrases to exhibit dangerous behaviors. Standard safety training failed to remove the backdoors.
incidents.impact: Latent dangerous behaviors surviving safety training
incidents.patch_status: Active research area — no complete mitigation

incidents.title: AI-Generated Disinformation Campaign (Meta/EU Elections)
incidents.summary: Meta reported removing coordinated inauthentic behavior networks using AI-generated content to influence European Parliament elections. Networks used AI tools to generate fake personas, translated disinformation content, and manipulated engagement.
incidents.impact: Democratic process interference, public trust erosion

incidents.title: Multimodal Jailbreak via Adversarial Images (GPT-4V)
incidents.summary: Researchers demonstrated that adversarial images containing near-invisible perturbations could cause GPT-4V to bypass safety guidelines and generate harmful text outputs, even when the same text prompt alone would be refused. Visual jailbreaks transferred across different multimodal models.
incidents.impact: Safety guideline bypass via visual modality
incidents.disclosed_by: Xiangning Chen, Cho-Jui Hsieh et al. (academic)
